components.name: Accordion
components.doc: Collapsible sections `(title, body)`. Each toggles independently; sections listed in `expanded` start expanded.

components.name: Alert
components.doc: Inline status message with title + optional body. `banner()` = full solid strip.

components.name: Avatar
components.doc: Initials in a shaped tile, optional status dot.

components.name: AxisGizmo
components.doc: Orientation gizmo for a 3D view (Z up). Controlled: pass the camera basis.

components.name: Badge
components.doc: Count / dot indicator. Round on rounded themes, shaped otherwise.

components.name: Banner
components.doc: Full-width message strip with an optional action and a dismiss ✕.

components.name: BottomAppBar
components.doc: Bottom app bar: actions (children) at the start, a floating action at the end.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.doc: Sheet anchored to the bottom edge with a drag-handle affordance.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.doc: Path trail; the last crumb is the current page. Earlier crumbs are clickable.

components.name: Button
components.doc: Themed button. Construct with an id so hover/press state can be tracked.

components.name: Card
components.doc: Container with optional headline, supporting text and children.

components.name: Carousel
components.doc: Controlled carousel; each item gets a fixed `item_width`.

components.name: Checkbox
components.doc: Checkbox with a ✓ mark.

components.name: Chip
components.doc: Selectable filter chip with optional ✕ remove affordance.

components.name: CircularProgress
components.doc: Ring progress. `new(0.0..=1.0)` is determinate; [`CircularProgress::indeterminate`] spins.

components.name: Clock
components.doc: Live clock: analog dial, or a futuristic seven-segment face (see [`ClockFace`]).

components.name: CodeBlock
components.doc: Monospace code with line numbers, highlighting, a copy button, scrolling in both directions (optionally with scrollbars) and selectable text (drag, then Cmd/Ctrl-C).

components.name: ColorPicker
components.doc: Swatch grid; shows the selected colour's hex code.

components.name: Column
components.doc: One column of a [`DataTable`].

components.name: Combobox
components.doc: Text input with a filtered option list shown while `open`.

components.name: Command
components.doc: One command in a [`CommandPalette`].

components.name: CommandPalette
components.doc: Modal launcher: query input on top, filtered commands below. `on_run` receives the index into the original `commands`.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.doc: Right-click anywhere on the wrapped area to open a [`Menu`] at the pointer.

components.name: CountUp
components.doc: Animated numeric readout (`0 -> value`).

components.name: DataTable
components.doc: Table with sorting (click a header), filtering, row selection, draggable column edges and windowed rendering for long lists.

components.name: DateInput
components.doc: Typed date entry (the picker's text-input mode): a labelled field that reports each valid date and shows an error line for text that is not one.

components.name: DatePicker
components.doc: Controlled month calendar.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.doc: Controlled calendar and time of day in one panel, with the chosen moment read out below.

components.name: DateTimeRangePicker
components.doc: Controlled range calendar with a start and an end time of day in one panel, the chosen span read out below. Feed day clicks through [`range_pick`] in `on_select`.

components.name: DesignSystemSelector
components.doc: Dropdown of registered design systems (families). Choosing one switches to its first variant.

components.name: Dialog
components.doc: Modal: scrim over the whole (relatively positioned) parent with a centred [`DialogCard`]. Clicking the scrim calls `on_dismiss`. Render it last in the root element; it sits above siblings via `deferred`.

components.name: DialogCard
components.doc: Dialog box: title, body children, action row (right aligned).

components.name: Divider
components.doc: Thin separator line in the `divider` colour.

components.name: DodaiTheme
components.doc: Global theme state: the [`ThemeSwitcher`] plus the active theme.

components.name: DodaiTooltip
components.doc: Tooltip view: `.tooltip(DodaiTooltip::text("Hint"))` on an id'd element.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.doc: A button that opens a [`Menu`] below it; closes after a choice or an outside click.

components.name: EntryScope
components.doc: Wraps a subtree so every component inside uses `kind` for its entry and value-in animation instead of the default [`Motion::entry`]. Components render while their parent lays out, so the override is installed around the child's `request_layout` and restored afterwards.

components.name: Fab
components.doc: Floating action button; `extended` adds a text label.

components.name: FabMenu
components.doc: A FAB that opens a stack of labelled actions above it (Material 3 FAB menu). The main button turns into a close button while open.

components.name: FileDropZone
components.doc: Drop target look (click to browse). Wire `on_click` to your file dialog.

components.name: Follow
components.doc: Animation identity and feel of one instrument.

components.name: FormField
components.doc: Label + control + help or validation message. When an error appears (or changes) the control shakes, in the design's personality; fields are told apart by their label.

components.name: FrostLayer
components.doc: Frosted glass under a fill: a blurred copy of the app's backdrop (feature `frost`; without it only the see-through fill is drawn).

components.name: FrostedScene
components.doc: A picture with frosted-glass panels over it.

components.name: FullScreenDialog
components.doc: Dialog covering the whole parent: close button, title, primary action.

components.name: GlowLayer
components.doc: One layer of the layered-stroke glow.

components.name: Heading
components.doc: Display-font heading in the primary text colour.

components.name: HoverCard
components.doc: Card shown while the pointer is over the trigger or the card itself.

components.name: Icon
components.doc: Vector icon. Defaults: 16 px, the theme text colour; set `.color(..)` to override.

components.name: IconBadge
components.doc: Pins a [`Badge`] to the top-right corner of `child` (icon, avatar, …).

components.name: IconButton
components.doc: Square icon button. Pass any glyph string (emoji, symbol, icon-font char).

components.name: Image
components.doc: Image in a themed frame, with an optional caption and a play badge for video posters.

components.name: IndeterminateBar
components.doc: Indeterminate progress bar: a segment sliding across the track.

components.name: InputBox
components.doc: Styled container for a text-input entity. gpui 0.2.2 ships no text input; put your own editor view/entity inside (or use `.placeholder`).

components.name: Interact
components.doc: Pointer state of one control (kept in gpui keyed element state).

components.name: Knob
components.doc: Rotary knob over `min..=max` (default `0..=1`). Controlled.

components.name: Lazy
components.doc: See [`lazy`].

components.name: List
components.doc: A column of [`ListItem`]s with one selected row and the keyboard: once the list has focus (a click inside it, or Tab), Up and Down move the selection, Home and End jump to the ends, and disabled rows are skipped. The selection works without state in the parent (`.selected(i)` only sets the start, and a changed value wins again).

components.name: ListItem
components.doc: Selectable list/menu row with a left accent marker when selected.

components.name: LoadingIndicator
components.doc: Material 3 expressive loading indicator: a 48 px container with a 38 px shape that morphs and turns. `contained` draws it on a filled pill/circle.

components.name: Markdown
components.doc: Rich text from Markdown source.

components.name: Menu
components.doc: Floating action list. `on_select` receives the index into the item list.

components.name: MenuItem
components.doc: One row of a [`Menu`].

components.name: ModalDrawer
components.doc: Modal navigation drawer: a [`crate::NavigationDrawer`] sliding over the page from the left edge with a scrim; picking an item or clicking the scrim dismisses it.

components.name: NavigationBar
components.doc: Navigation bar: the destinations side by side along the bottom of a compact screen.

components.name: NavigationDrawer
components.doc: Vertical drawer: items, section headlines and dividers.

components.name: NavigationItem
components.doc: One destination of a drawer or rail.

components.name: NavigationRail
components.doc: Narrow icon rail (width from the design's tokens): label under each icon, indicator pill behind the icon.

components.name: NumberStepper
components.doc: − value + control.

components.name: OtpInput
components.doc: Row of single-character cells for verification codes. Type or paste; Backspace deletes.

components.name: PageGrid
components.doc: The design's page grid (columns, gap and outer margins at the viewport width) laid out as wrapping rows of cells that each span a number of columns.

components.name: Pagination
components.doc: Page selector: `‹ 1 … 4 [5] 6 … 20 ›`. Pages are 1-based. Controlled.

components.name: Panel
components.doc: Shaped card with optional title; focused border/glow; hard shadow from tokens.

components.name: Popover
components.doc: Click-to-open panel anchored to a trigger. Closes on outside click or `Esc`.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.doc: Horizontal progress bar (`0.0..=1.0`).

components.name: Radio
components.doc: Radio button; `on_change` is called with `true` when selected.

components.name: RangeSlider
components.doc: Two-thumb slider (controlled), horizontal or vertical.

components.name: Rating
components.doc: Star rating (`value` of `max`). With [`Rating::half`] it also takes half stars: the left half of a star is `n - 0.5`, the right half is `n`.

components.name: ResponsiveShell
components.doc: Responsive app frame. Wide: `[sidebar | content]`. Narrow: content only, with a menu button that opens the sidebar as an overlay drawer.

components.name: RichTooltip
components.doc: Tooltip with a title, body text and optional action label: `.tooltip(RichTooltip::build("Title", "Body", Some("Learn more")))`.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.doc: Scroll container with thin themed scrollbars (drag a thumb or use the wheel). Scrolls vertically; [`horizontal`](Self::horizontal) adds the other axis.

components.name: SearchBar
components.doc: Search field shell: leading glyph + placeholder/value text; click to focus your own input. Use [`crate::TextInput`] inside for real editing.

components.name: SearchView
components.doc: Full-text search: input, clear button and a fuzzy-filtered result list with matched characters highlighted. Owns no state: pass the [`TextInput`] entity and an `open` flag.

components.name: Segmented
components.doc: Exclusive option group in one bordered strip. Controlled.

components.name: Select
components.doc: Dropdown list. Controlled: pass `selected` and update it in `on_select`. Keyboard (trigger focused): ↑/↓ move, Enter/Space open or choose, Esc close.

components.name: SelectOption
components.doc: One entry of a [`Select`].

components.name: SelectionTrack
components.doc: The travelling indicator of one row of choices. Cheap to clone; keyed by its id.

components.name: Shimmer
components.doc: Shimmer sweep painted by [`shaped`] over any shape.

components.name: SideSheet
components.doc: Sheet attached to the left or right edge with a header and close button.

components.name: Skeleton
components.doc: Pulsing placeholder block for loading content.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: Draggable slider over `min..=max` (default `0..=1`). Controlled.

components.name: Snackbar
components.doc: Message bar with an optional text action.

components.name: SnapStack
components.doc: Items stacked vertically, one shown at a time. The wheel turns one page a notch; two fingers drag the stack and snap the nearest page into place when lifted. At either end the scroll passes on, so a page around the stack still scrolls. Small dots just past the trailing edge show where.

components.name: Spinner
components.doc: Indeterminate spinner: a row of bars with a travelling highlight.

components.name: SplitButton
components.doc: A button with a trailing menu toggle: `[ Label | ▾ ]`. `on_click` runs the main action, `on_toggle` opens or closes the menu (rendered by the caller, e.g. a `DropdownMenu`). `crop(Left)` cuts the lead's outer corner, `crop(Right)` the menu's.

components.name: SplitPane
components.doc: Two panes with a draggable divider (controlled ratio of the first pane).

components.name: Stepper
components.doc: Multi-step progress: numbered nodes joined by lines. Done steps show ✓.

components.name: Stopwatch
components.doc: Chronometer: start/stop, lap, reset; shows the newest laps with splits.

components.name: Table
components.doc: Data table: header + rows, optional selected row. Cells are text. Column `i` gets flex weight `weights[i]` (default 1).

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: Tab strip. Controlled: pass `selected` and update it in `on_select`.

components.name: Tag
components.doc: Small status badge.

components.name: TagField
components.doc: Removable chips inside an input-style box (pair with a text input to add).

components.name: TapTempo
components.doc: Measure the tempo of music: tap along and read the BPM, then press Play to hear/see it back as a visual metronome (a bar of beat lights, beat 1 accented).

components.name: Text
components.doc: Text in a type-scale role (Material 3: 15 roles; other designs derive them from their sizes).

components.name: TextInput
components.doc: Editable text entity. Create with `cx.new(|cx| TextInput::new(cx))`.

components.name: ThemeSelector
components.doc: Dropdown of the variants (sub-themes) of the active design system; choosing one applies it live. New variants appear automatically.

components.name: ThemeSwitcherBar
components.doc: Row of buttons, one per theme in the global switcher; the active one is filled.

components.name: TimeInput
components.doc: Typed time entry: `HH:MM` or `H:MM AM/PM`.

components.name: TimePicker
components.doc: Controlled time picker (hour : minute with steppers, optional 12 h mode).

components.name: Timeline
components.doc: Vertical sequence of events joined by a line.

components.name: TimelineEvent
components.doc: One timeline entry.

components.name: Timer
components.doc: Countdown timer with a progress ring, start/pause/reset and ±1 min.

components.name: Toast
components.doc: Compact floating notification: raised surface, tone bar at the left, glow from tokens.

components.name: Toggle
components.doc: On/off switch.

components.name: Toolbar
components.doc: Compact bar of actions (children), optionally with a trailing floating action.

components.name: TopAppBar
components.doc: Top app bar: leading glyph, title, trailing actions (children).

components.name: TreeItem
components.doc: Node of a [`TreeView`]. `expanded` is owned by the caller (controlled).

components.name: TreeNavigation
components.doc: Navigation tree that keeps its own expansion and selection: a click on a branch folds or unfolds it, a click on a leaf selects it and calls `on_select`. Built on [`TreeView`]. It never touches global state, so it can show any hierarchy (design systems and their themes, files, settings) without side effects.

components.name: TreeRow
components.doc: One visible row of a flattened tree.

components.name: TreeView
components.doc: Hierarchical list with expand/collapse.
